segments.text: She is the girl with whom Towa first met when he got lost in this world, caring Towa in various ways.
As the daughter of the Linestad family that inherit hero's blood, she received sword training from her father when she lived in the mansion deep in the forest of the royal capital, Salem.
Due to her father's missing, she is currently working at a cafe so as to pay off the debt.
Although she doesn't know much about the world and clumsy, she always holds a positive attitude towards everything with all her might.
Not doubting other people, she encounters dangers from time to time.
Translated from official website
永羽が異世界に迷い込んだ際に最初に出会った少女で、永羽の事を気遣い色々と世話をしてくれる。
英雄の血を引く名家・ラインスタッド家の娘で、王都セイレムの森の奥に佇む屋敷で暮らしていた時は、父親から剣技の手ほどきを受けていた。現在はその父親が失踪した影響で没落し、借金返済のためカフェで働いている。
世間知らずで不器用だが、何事にも常に前向きで一生懸命。人を疑う事をしない為、度々危ない目に遭う。

segments.text: She is the daughter of a nobleman in Zeil Kingdom, which has been hostile to Yugudora Kingdom for many years. She met with Towa and his friends when she came to Yugudora as an international student.
Since black is regarded as a holy color in Zeil Kingdom, she is completely dressed in black, but it's thought to be an odd appearance in Salem, though.
Her family is so wealthy that she has a strange money sense, tending to solve everything with money.
Translated from official website
ユグドラ・キングダムとは長年敵国だったムーア王国の貴族の娘で、留学生としてユグドラ・キングダムにやってきた際に永羽達と知り合う。
黒が神聖な色だとされるムーア王国らしく、全身黒色の衣装を纏っており、王都セイレムでは変わった格好として見られている。
家が超がつく程お金持ちだった為に金銭感覚がおかしく、なんでもお金で解決しがち。喧嘩っ早い性格で、争いがあると好んで突っ込んでいく。

segments.text: She is a girl with black hair from the remote, far east. When Yugudora Kingdom expanded further east, a state of war developed in the region, and she, whose hometown had been destroyed, came to the royal capital for a certain reason.
Her skill of sword reaches a genius level, which can be demonstrated completely even in the "Clarias".
Mysterious as she is, she often feels hungry and patronizes the cafe where Shelly works.
Translated from official website
遥か極東からやってきた黒髪の少女。ユグドラ・キングダムが極東にも勢力を伸ばしたことで戦争状態となり、故郷を滅ぼされた彼女はある理由で王都を訪れた。
剣の腕は天才的であり、その実力は鎧でもいかんなく発揮される。
性格はサバサバとしているが、時折血も涙もない事を悪びれもせず話す事がある。
謎の多い人物であるが、よく腹を空かせており、シェリーが働くカフェに通い詰める事になる。

She is a detective girl who looks like a boy, using "boku" to call herself. In fact, Towa thinks she is a boy.

Entrust by the police, she has solved various difficult cases with her exceptional reasoning ability. Because Towa, a suspicious oriental person from a different world, was thought to be the criminal of a case, she became hostile to Towa and his friends.
She doesn't trust people basically. Therefore, she doesn’t rely on other people, preferring to act alone.
Translated from official website
男の子のような容姿をしている探偵少女。自分の事をボクと言うのもあり、現に永羽は彼女を男の子だと思っている。
警察から依頼され、類まれなる推理力によって様々な難事件を解決している。ある事件の犯人が、異世界からきた怪しい東洋人、永羽だと考えた事で、永羽達と敵対する事となる。
基本的に人を信用していない。その為人に頼るという事ができず、単独行動を好む。

Finding a mysterious egg during the school trip, he was taken to a different world. Although he is unwilling to fight in a strange armor in that world, he can basically control it thanks to his previous fighting experience.
He is trying to find a way to return to his original world step by step with his either originally optimistic attitude or the thought that nature will take its course.
He is also concerned about his young sister Hirose, who used to live with him, but now is left alone.
Translated from official website
As a maid serving Linestad family, she is the only person who continues staying by Shelly's side even after the decline of Linestad family.
She is now working at the cafe with Shelly, and her cooking is well received.
She is reticent, clam and reliable, watching over naive Shelly in the shadow.
Translated from official website
He is the chief police officer of the royal capital with strong physique and fierce eyes.
He and his subordinate Lilo often patronize cafe where Shelly works.
Suspecting Towa in an incident which is relevant to an armor, he interrogated Towa violently in a way that is close to threat.
Translated from official website
He is a police officer of the royal capital police. Although instructed arbitrarily by his boss Glen, he doesn't care it so much.
Even though he belongs to police, he is slack in discipline, such as feeling sympathy to suspects, giving them advice instead and leaking the internal information of the police to outside.
Translated from official website
Suspicious as he looks, he is one of the heroes who led the past war to victory.
Having distinguished experiences, currently he is the principle of Salem School which is oriented towards noble children.
He also helped Shelly's parents after the decline of Linestad family.
Translated from official website
She is the elite of the elite born and grown up in Ray family that enjoys a high reputation in Yugudora Kingdom.
She belongs to The Knights of Seiryuu together with her brother.
She performs intelligence mission in the kingdom, appearing and disapperaing mysteriously.
Having a strong sense of self-esteem, she is taciturn and hard to get along with.
For certain reasons she harboured resentment against Towa, aiming at his life.
Translated from official website
One of the heroes who led the war to victory 15 years ago.
As a result of his immersing in battle, his body was integrated with armor.
He is currently the boss of the mafia, running an arena in a slum area to make money.
Translated from official website

segments.text: A man in armor sometimes can be met in night.
His personality is violent, treating power as everything.
He is interested in the music player that Towa listens to and often seizes it forcibly.
But surprisingly, he and Towa are compatible.
Translated from official website
He manages the vigilante in kingdom's guild.
Covering both of his eyes is impressive in terms of appearance, he is easygoing, though. Towa and his friends are often taken care of in the guild as well.
Translated from official website
He is the head of Ray family that enjoys a high reputation in Yugudora Kingdom, also the leader of The Knights of Seiryuu and Chris's older brother.
He takes pride in Ray family and doesn't mind any command as long as it's for protecting the kingdom. He has a strong and inflexible aspect as well.
His stoic spirit demonstrates in his exceptional swordsmanship, too.
Translated from official website
A member of The Knights of Seiryuu.
She serves as a shield on battle despite her unwillingness to be injured.
Although her ability is high, she is lack of enthusiasm, often taking paid holidays.
Translated from official website
